mapper.update: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS expense_record ( record_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT, record_date DATE, expense_id INTEGER, memo VARCHAR(80), deposit INTEGER, withdraw INTEGER, FOREIGN KEY (expense_id) REFERENCES expense_category(expense_id) )
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS expense_category ( expense_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT, expense_name VARCHAR(20), expense_bool BOOLEAN NOT NULL )
mapper.select:
SELECT r.record_id, r.record_date, c.expense_name, r.memo, r.deposit, r.withdraw FROM expense_record AS r LEFT JOIN expense_category AS c ON r.expense_id = c.expense_id ORDER BY r.record_date
ASC DESC
SELECT expense_id, expense_name, expense_bool FROM expense_category
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO expense_record (record_date, expense_id, memo, deposit, withdraw) VALUES (#{record_date},#{expense_id},#{memo},#{deposit},#{withdraw})
